name: Horoshop
description: Horoshop online stores (Ukraine): orders with status and payment updates, catalog export and import of prices, stock and texts, catalog sections, customers, delivery and payment options, currencies. API administrator login and password.
instructions:
## Horoshop
This connector works with the **Horoshop API** of a Ukrainian Horoshop online store, at `https://<your store domain>/api/`: orders and their statuses, the product catalog (export and import of prices, stock and texts), catalog sections, registered customers, delivery and payment options, currencies and stickers.

**Setup (about 3 minutes)**
1. In the store's admin panel open **Settings, Admins** (Налаштування, Адміністратори) and add an administrator for the API with a login and a password; give it only the rights the tools need.
2. Enter the login in `HOROSHOP_LOGIN` and the password in `HOROSHOP_PASSWORD`.
3. Enter the store domain without https:// in `HOROSHOP_DOMAIN`, for example `shop123456.horoshop.ua` or your own domain. The store must be reachable over https.

The connector calls `api/auth/` with the login and password, receives a token valid for 600 seconds, puts it into the body of every call as `token` and logs in again when Horoshop answers UNAUTHORIZED.

**Where to start**: `horoshop_list_orders` with a `from` date (and `additional_data` true for waybills), then `horoshop_update_order` to move an order on. For products use `horoshop_export_products` with an `expr` filter on articles or a section.

**Orders**: `horoshop_list_orders`, `horoshop_list_order_statuses` (Horoshop 4 and later), `horoshop_update_order` (status, paid flag, Ukrposhta tracking code). `horoshop_cancel_order` is installed switched off. Standard status ids: 1 new, 2 processing, 3 delivered, 4 not delivered (Canceled), 6 shipping; stores can add their own.

**Catalog**: `horoshop_export_products` (up to 500 per call), `horoshop_import_products` (create or update by article: price, presence, residues per warehouse, texts, images), `horoshop_list_categories`, `horoshop_list_stickers`. Products with modifications share a `parent_article`. Texts can be per language (`ua`, `ru`, `en`) or one value for all. Stock: `presence` is accepted only while warehouse stock accounting is off; with it on, send `residues`.

**Customers**: `horoshop_list_customers` and `horoshop_import_customers` (by email).

**Shop settings**: `horoshop_list_delivery_options`, `horoshop_list_delivery_types`, `horoshop_list_payment_options`, `horoshop_list_payment_methods`, `horoshop_list_currencies`.

**Answers**: every answer has `status` and `response`. OK is success, EMPTY means no results, WARNING means some rows of an import or update failed (see `response.log`), ERROR, EXCEPTION and HTTP_ERROR are failures that the connector reports with `response.message`. Calls and answers can be checked at `https://<your store domain>/api/logs/` after signing in to the admin. Prices are in the store currency, usually UAH. Horoshop publishes no fixed rate limit; avoid many calls per second.

HOROSHOP_DOMAIN.label: Store domain
HOROSHOP_DOMAIN.help: The domain of your Horoshop store without https://, e.g. shop123456.horoshop.ua or mystore.com.ua.
HOROSHOP_DOMAIN.patternMessage: Enter only the domain in lower case, e.g. shop123456.horoshop.ua, without https:// and without a path.

HOROSHOP_LOGIN.label: API login
HOROSHOP_LOGIN.help: The login of the administrator you created for the API in Settings, Admins.

401.hint: Horoshop refused the login or the token (UNAUTHORIZED or AUTHORIZATION_ERROR). Check the API administrator's login and password in Settings, Admins.

verifyHints.403: Horoshop refused the call: the API administrator lacks the rights for this function.

404.hint: Horoshop does not know this function here (UNDEFINED_FUNCTION or no API at this domain). Check the store domain; some functions need Horoshop 4.

verifyHints.rate_limited: Horoshop throttled the calls. Wait a moment and try again.

unreachable.hint: No Horoshop store answers at this domain over https. Check the domain.

prerequisites: A Horoshop store and an admin account that may add administrators (for the API login and password). About 3 minutes.

tools.name: horoshop_list_orders
tools.description: List orders: order_id, stat_status (1 new, 2 processing, 3 delivered, 4 not delivered or canceled, 6 shipping, plus custom statuses), stat_created, delivery name, email, phone, city and address, delivery_type, payment_type, payed (1 or 0), total_sum, currency, discounts, coupon, manager comment and products (title, article, price, quantity, total_price). With additional_data also delivery_data (Nova Poshta or Ukrposhta waybill number and status). EMPTY means nothing matched.

from.description: Orders placed from this date: YYYY-MM-DD, DD.MM.YYYY or with time YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss (inclusive).

to.description: Orders placed up to this date: YYYY-MM-DD, DD.MM.YYYY or with time YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss (inclusive).

status.description: Order status ids, e.g. [1, 2]; list them with horoshop_list_order_statuses.

additional_data.description: true: include additional_data and delivery_data (waybill, warehouses, recipient).

offset.description: How many rows to skip, from 0. Works together with limit.

tools.name: horoshop_list_order_statuses
tools.description: List the order statuses of the shop (Horoshop 4 and later): id, title per language (ua, en) and is_successful (whether the status counts as delivered).

tools.name: horoshop_update_order
tools.description: Change one order: set its status (any status id except 4, which cancels and is a separate tool), mark it paid or unpaid, and add a Ukrposhta tracking code. The answer's log says per order whether it was UPDATED.

status.description: New status id as text: 1 new, 2 processing, 3 delivered, 6 shipping, or a custom status id from horoshop_list_order_statuses. 4 (cancel) is refused here.

tracking_code.description: Ukrposhta tracking code shown to the customer.

tools.name: horoshop_cancel_order
tools.description: Set an order to status 4 (not delivered, shown as Canceled). Installed switched off.

tools.name: horoshop_export_products
tools.description: Export catalog products: article, parent_article (groups modifications), title per language, price, price_old, discount, presence (stock status), residues per warehouse, brand, parent (category path), display_in_showcase, images, link, gtin, mpn, characteristics and more. At most 500 per call; page with offset and limit.

expr.description: Filter, any of: `parent` (category path such as `Toys / Baby toys`), `parent` as `{"id": [1, 2]}` (category ids), `article` (one article or a list, Horoshop 3.21.1 and later), `display_in_showcase` (1 shown, 0 hidden). Example: `{"article": ["SKU-1-BLACK", "MF-2010"]}`.

included_params.description: Return only these fields (plus article, parent_article and parent), e.g. ["price", "price_old", "title"].

offset.description: How many rows to skip, from 0. Works together with limit.

tools.name: horoshop_import_products
tools.description: Create or update products by article: price, price_old, presence, residues per warehouse (when stock accounting is on), title, descriptions, category (parent), brand, display_in_showcase, images and other fields as in Horoshop's catalog/import. Fields left out keep their value. The log reports per article what was done; WARNING means some rows failed.

products.description: Products, at most 100 per call. Each needs article; a new product also needs title and parent (category path or `{"id": 12}`). Example: `[{"article": "SKU-1", "price": 499, "presence": "в наявності", "residues": [{"warehouse": "office", "quantity": 5}]}]`. Caution: images with links replace the gallery unless override is false.

tools.name: horoshop_list_categories
tools.description: List catalog sections (pages) under a parent: id, parent, title per language, discount and image. Use the ids in product filters and imports.

parent.description: Parent section id; 0 is the root.

tools.name: horoshop_list_customers
tools.description: Export registered customers: id, title (name), email, phone, country, city, address, registered, newsletter_subscription and manager note (B2B shops also group, balance and manager). EMPTY means none matched.

from.description: Customers registered from this date: YYYY-MM-DD, DD.MM.YYYY or with time YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss (inclusive).

to.description: Customers registered before this date: YYYY-MM-DD, DD.MM.YYYY or with time YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss (inclusive).

offset.description: How many rows to skip, from 0. Works together with limit.

tools.name: horoshop_import_customers
tools.description: Create or update customers by email: title (full name, required), email (required, unique), phone, country, city, address, newsletter_subscription, a personal discount card and the manager note. The log has a code per customer: 0 done, 1 missing fields, 2 invalid fields.

users.description: Customers, at most 100 per call. Example: `[{"title": "Ivan Petrenko", "email": "ivan@example.com", "phone": "+380501234567"}]`.

tools.name: horoshop_list_delivery_options
tools.description: List delivery options: id, title per language, type (delivery type id), enabled, by_carrier (price by carrier tariffs), payment (allowed payment option ids) and price_options (order total thresholds and prices).

tools.name: horoshop_list_delivery_types
tools.description: List delivery types (for example Nova Poshta, Ukrposhta, pickup): id and title per language.

tools.name: horoshop_list_payment_options
tools.description: List payment options: id, title and description per language, payment_method id, enabled, icon, payment link and payment instruction.

tools.name: horoshop_list_payment_methods
tools.description: List payment methods: id, title and is_simple (true: the buyer goes to the thank-you page, false: to a payment gateway).

tools.name: horoshop_list_currencies
tools.description: List currencies and exchange rates: id, iso, title and exchangeRates (relatedIso, exchangeCourse). A cheap call to check the connection.

enabled_only.description: true: only currencies enabled on the storefront (then iso is ignored).

tools.name: horoshop_list_stickers
tools.description: List product stickers (icons such as New or Sale) of a Horoshop 4 shop: id, title and enabled.
